title: FsStore: no disk-space soft cap (max_bytes not implemented)
description: The bead spec for stoa-da45c369 included 'soft cap enforcement if max_bytes configured', but FsBackendConfig has no max_bytes field and no enforcement is implemented. A disk-fill condition silently turns every put_raw into WriteFailed with 'No space left on device', which the pipeline treats as a store failure and rejects articles. Operators have no way to configure a proactive threshold. Should add max_bytes: Option<u64> to FsBackendConfig and check total directory usage before writing.
